description: Looks up restaurants by name, including partial names and imperfect spelling, and returns an MCP App card for each match. An optional city argument limits the search to one city.

history_n.description: How many recent inspections to include per restaurant. Default 3.

limit.description: Max number of matches to return (1-50).

query.description: Restaurant name or partial name (e.g., 'giordanos', 'shake shak').

threshold.description: Fuzzy match threshold between 0 and 1 (higher = stricter).

name: search_restaurants
